method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A is an EMPTY schedule: the filer wrote the word NONE across the name, address and amount columns of the first band and NONE on the printed TOTAL line. Zero rows emitted, which is a real zero. Cover line 1 carries a slashed-zero glyph in the Totals-from-LAST-Report column (=0 per the zero-glyph ruling) and the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells are blank, with a single diagonal stroke drawn across the CUMULATIVE column over all four lines. This is the filer's only 2020 report (period 03/19/2020-06/15/2020, no earlier filing exists in the module), so the period and cycle scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: Cover line 3 (total campaign expenses) is BLANK in all three columns, so the county-branded Form B's own printed TOTAL is the ONLY anchor for this side. Rows 120.53 + 9.00 = 129.53 = the printed TOTAL, read at 1200 dpi. The cover's line-4 balance cell (Totals-from-LAST-Report column) carries the same figure 129.53. Both expenditure dates (2020-03-23, 2020-04-07) fall inside the certified period 03/19/2020-06/15/2020 and this is the filer's only report of the cycle, so period == cumulative.

gates.page_subtotal: p3 rows 120.53 + 9.00 = 129.53 = printed TOTAL 129.53 (gate fires exactly, and it is the gate that settled the row-1 hundreds digit: a 200-dpi read left 120.53/170.53 open, and only 120.53 closes the printed total). p2 has no numeric total - the printed TOTAL line reads the word NONE.

gates.balance_chain: Does NOT close as a signed chain: contributions 0 - expenditures 129.53 = -129.53, but the cover's only balance figure is +129.53, written unsigned in the Totals-from-LAST-Report column (the same column where the filer put his line-1 zero) while THIS and CUMULATIVE are struck through. The filer appears to have entered the expenditure total on the balance line. No earlier filing exists for this filer in this cycle, so the cross-filing cumulative chain cannot be run.
